name: Mirza Mughal
seoTitle: Mirza Mughal: Delhi Rebel Commander in the 1857 Uprising
seoDescription: Mirza Mughal, son of Mughal emperor Bahadur Shah Zafar, commanded rebel forces in Delhi during the 1857 uprising against East India Company rule. Explore his role in India's anti-colonial resistance.
role: Mughal prince and rebel organizer in Delhi
contribution: Associated with the Indian Rebellion of 1857 through leadership, mobilization, or battlefield action in their region.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: Remembered in 1857 historiography as part of the coalition that challenged East India Company rule.
